home.headline: Senior developer for websites, internal tools and real-time 3D/VR experiences.
home.subheadline: I use AI when it genuinely improves delivery: faster on repetitive work, without turning technical decisions into a black box.

trust.title: Senior delivery, AI under control and production-ready execution
trust.intro: AI is there to accelerate execution when it actually helps. Scoping, code quality and shipping still get handled like a real project, not like a demo.

direct.label: Faster technical decisions, direct communication and clear responsibility from scoping to production

delivery.label: Automate repetitive work where it helps, keep human judgment on trade-offs, review and sensitive code

quality.label: Performance, SEO, versioning and clean deployment instead of a fragile prototype

process.title: A simple framework to scope, build and ship properly
process.intro: The work moves in three steps: clarify the need, build quickly with the right tools, then publish something reliable.

discovery.title: Clarify the need before building anything
discovery.body: We define the business problem, the intended user and the ambition level before choosing the stack, format or amount of automation.

points.goals: Define what needs to be delivered, who it serves and what will make the project genuinely useful.
points.queries: Surface the product, SEO, content or demo constraints that materially change the solution.
points.plan: Choose a realistic scope: page, app, prototype or existing product that needs hardening.

build.title: Move fast without losing technical readability
build.body: AI can accelerate part of the delivery, but technical direction stays owned. The goal is speed without ending up with an opaque or brittle base.

stackItems.delivery: AI workflow · GitHub · short PRs · visible review checkpoints

launch.title: Make the result reliable, maintainable and ready to ship
launch.body: The last step is not cosmetic. We check what is actually going live, what should be measured next and what needs to remain easy to take over later.

verify.body: Review content, links, readability, technical quality and the points most likely to break in production.

publish.body: Version, review, deploy cleanly and keep a clear record of what changed.

measure.body: Leave behind a base that can be iterated on, handed over or extended without starting over from scratch.

proof.title: Named stack, visible workflow and public references
proof.intro: Before we even speak, you can already see the technologies in use, the way work gets delivered and the public profiles connected to it. AI is part of the workflow, not a smokescreen.

web.title: Websites, pages and internal tools that need to hold up in production
web.body: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Laravel, WordPress and technical SEO to build web surfaces that are fast, readable and serious to operate.

realtime.title: Demonstrators that make an idea concrete faster
realtime.body: Unreal, Unity and WebGL to test an interaction, present a concept or make a complex subject easier to sell and understand.

trust.title: AI speeds up execution, not accountability
trust.body: AI tools save time on repetitive work. Scoping, review and production decisions still stay owned end to end.
